note: Scripture source: the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, CC BY-SA 4.0), fetched as USX from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx), all 66 books. Every mined span was sliced from that text by script, never typed. Each day's promise verse is the IRV text of the cited reference verbatim (the IRV's own inner quotation marks removed); citations use the Hindi book names with Western digits, the English's Roman book prefixes (I Sam., II Kings) becoming 1 शमूएल, 2 राजाओं.

Quotation marks: the English edition uses straight double quotes; the Hindi uses curly “ ” as every shipped Hindi book does, mirroring the English's own pairing per block — including the handful of quotations the English never closes (or closes without opening), which are mirrored, not repaired.

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND the measurement confirms it (a 6+ character quoted segment of that block, or an 8+ character phrase in the chapter, is a byte substring of the cited IRV verse). adapted/self rows and 4 unconfirmed verbatim claims (2 Thess 3:9 ch04, Matt 18:32 ch06, 2 Cor 11:24 ch11, Prov 30:15 ch12) are self_rendered. Unquoted echoes are not recorded. 681 mined, 55 self_rendered.

PROMISE TEXTS WHERE THE IRV READS DIFFERENTLY and the day's meditation turns on the KJV word (IRV kept in the promise line; Spurgeon's point carried in his own sentences, noted per chapter in the translators' reports): Dec 24 Deut 33:29 — the IRV's तेरे शत्रु तुझे सराहेंगे ('flatter') where the KJV has 'shall be found liars unto thee', bridged by one clause in the meditation; Nov 21 Isa 45:22 'look' (IRV फिरो); Oct 19 Jer 30:11 'in measure' (IRV विचार करके); Sept 15 Isa 32:2 'a man' (IRV हर एक); Aug 30 2 Sam 23:5 (IRV a question); July 16 Zeph 3:19; Apr 18 Josh 1:5 'fail' (IRV धोखा देना); Mar 15 Ezek 11:16 'little sanctuary'; Mar 8 Deut 28:5 'store'; Feb 2 Mal 4:2 'grow up'; Jan 25 Job 33:27-28. Self-rendered single phrases where a meditation's whole point rests on a KJV word the IRV lacks: Eph 1:6 'accepted in the Beloved', Heb 10:34 'in yourselves', Hab 2:3 'it shall speak', Gen 49:19 'overcome at the last', Ps 37:3 'verily thou shalt be fed', Hos 2:14 (from the Hebrew), Phil 3:21 (Spurgeon's RV/KJV comparison), Dan 5:27 (the reversed verdict), Isa 54:12 'window of agate'.

IRV readings kept byte-exact though they look like slips: 2 Sam 5:24 मेरे आगे (the promise line; the meditation's own quotation says तेरे आगे), Isa 35:9 ओर for और, 2 Chr 15:7 बाँधों. Citations corrected in the Hindi: Apr 19 'Exod. 34:11' → Ezek 34:11; narration 'like Dan' → Gad (May 11).

Conventions: the reader addressed as तुम, God in prayer as तू; God and Christ in the singular; the governing image — cheque चेक, bank बैंक, to cash/present भुनाना / प्रस्तुत करना; date lines as 1 जनवरी …; day titles as short Hindi phrases; 'the Comforter' शान्तिदाता where the English plays on comfort (Mar 14, from IRV Isa 51:12); Spurgeon's companion books rendered सुबह-दर-सुबह / शाम-दर-शाम (no established Hindi titles).
